title: Sprint Signal: Annotated Standup — 2027-04-14
body:
Purpose: quick annotated capture of morning standup with signal snippets and action items. Use this as the primary single source for sprint-blocking items we want to escalate to SRE or PMs.

Attendees:
- Priya (owner)
- Ethan (frontend)
- Maya (analytics)
- Samir (rollout infra)
- Lena (QA)

Quick status (30s each):
- Priya: UI refresh experiment A/B ready; accessibility fixes in branch; need final copy for empty-state.
- Ethan: telemetry hook for panel impressions merged to staging; observed mismatch on impression vs render count (see telemetry notes).
- Maya: canary metrics dashboard updated; new 95th percentile tracer for rollout latency; requesting a brief runbook for pager thresholds.
- Samir: capacity bump for dedicated canary scheduled tonight; validating fallback model routing in test cluster.
- Lena: smoke tests flakey on 2 browsers; filing reproducible cases.

Signals / Observations (annotated)
1) Impressions vs renders delta (Ethan, Maya)
   - Symptom: staging shows 14% more 'impression' events than 'render_complete' for the Panel list. Suspect double-counting in fast mount/unmount scenario.
   - Evidence: event dump (analytics query) shows event sequence impression -> impression -> render_complete in ~2% of sessions, but long tail where impression x2 then no render_complete.
   - Immediate action: Ethan to add guard to not emit impression if mounting key unchanged (PR #812).
   - Probe query (Maya): SELECT event, count(*) FROM events WHERE path LIKE '/panel%' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY event; will run and paste in thread.
2) Canary latency variance (Maya, Samir)
   - Symptom: Canary region us-west-2 saw an increase in 95th token-generation latency during a burst test.
   - Hypothesis: autoscaler cold-start interaction with qcache priming; small cohort of requests hit cold model variant.
   - Temporary mitigation: Samir to restrict canary traffic to steady ramp (no >20% sudden spikes) for next 24h.
   - Next: add a metric for 'model-variant cold-start' and map to traceID for investigation.

Rollout/Experiment notes
- UI refresh experiment A/B (branch ui/refresh-a11y):
  - Variant A: compact panel, progressive render placeholder
  - Variant B: full panel with skeletons
  - Goal metric: improve time-to-first-interaction (TTFI) and reduce dropdown mis-hits.
  - Success criteria: +5% TTFI at p50 and no >1% regression in conversion funnel.
  - Tracking: using rollout flag rn.ui.refresh with exposure logging. Maya to add a funnel that ties rollout flag -> exposed -> clicked_primary.

Telemetry and Queries (Maya)
- Canary dashboard quick queries to paste in thread:
  1) Panel impression vs render: SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS h, count_if(event='panel_impression') AS impressions, count_if(event='panel_render') AS renders FROM analytics.events WHERE ts > now() - interval '14 days' GROUP BY h ORDER BY h DESC LIMIT 48;
  2) 95th token latency by variant: SELECT variant, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY token_latency_ms) FROM inference.calls WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY variant;
  3) Canary error breakdown: SELECT error_code, count(*) FROM inference.errors WHERE is_canary = true AND ts > now() - interval '3 days' GROUP BY error_code;

Blocked / Risks
- QA flakes on Safari 15 (Lena): blocks final sign-off for A/B. Root cause suspected CSS repaint race in skeletons. Action: Ethan to drop a minimal repro, Lena to attach HAR and video. Target: fix by 2027-04-16.
- Missing runbook for rollout-induced latency alerts (Maya): currently SRE will page on infra latency but not on model fallback rate. Need to author short runbook. Owner: Priya, due 2027-04-18.
- Canary capacity bump might expose private model fallback (Samir): risk of sending requests to cheaper variant causing slight quality regression. Communication: add banner note to rollout dashboard for model variant mapping. Owner: Samir.

Decisions made
- Pause automated aggressive ramp for canary until "model-variant cold-start" metric is being emitted. (Decision: Samir, Priya)
- Convert impression event to idempotent emission: add client-side dedupe key to avoid double-counting (Decision: Ethan)

Actions and owners (short list)
- Ethan: open hotfix PR to add mounting guard and dedupe key for impressions. Target: 2027-04-15 EOD. Linked PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/812
- Maya: add rollout funnel and the 95th percentile tracer to canary dashboard; attach queries above. Target: 2027-04-15 AM.
- Samir: postpone any >20% traffic ramps; add model-variant cold-start metric to infra telemetry. Target: 2027-04-15.
- Lena: collect Safari HAR/video and attach to ticket JIRA-UI-235. Target: 2027-04-15.
- Priya: draft short runbook for rollout latency and model-fallback paging and circulate to SRE/PM. Target: 2027-04-18.

Notes-to-self / Loose ideas (brainstorm fragments)
- Consider small client-side KV cache for panel state to avoid re-mount spikes during nav.
- Evaluate adding a lightweight heartbeat for long-poll panels to keep render pipeline warm (low priority).
- Could we sample request traces with the rollout flag tag to quickly pivot if quality regressions appear? (Maya)

Follow-ups (next standup)
- Confirm fix for double impressions on staging (Ethan demo).
- Canary dashboard updated and new metrics visible (Maya).
- Safari repro and hotfix plan (Lena).
- Runbook draft review with SRE (Priya).

Appendix: useful links / snippets
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/812
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-UI-235
- Slack thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C02CONSOLE/p1649876543210000
- Quick trace sample id: trace-20270413-34b2 (Maya)

End.
